changelog: Lifecycle fixes: teardown now stops the child processes and waits for the lanes instead of leaving them reading the share; the sync pump survives a failing pass and logs it; a killed extraction is reported as cancelled instead of failing down the fallback chain; and a failed prefetch reports the fault that actually happened
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
